vulnerability_type: Single Point of Control - Staking Contract Change

preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain control of owner account)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setStakingContract() to set the staking contract address to a malicious contract controlled by the attacker. Then call deliver() from the malicious contract to mint unlimited tokens to the attacker's address, bypassing the mint() function's onlyOwner restriction and increasing the attacker's token balance.
